The '''2025 Retro League''' was the fourth season of the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], with a flat \$10 entry fee.<ref name="t85234" /> [[Steve Sanders]] was the tournament director.<ref name="t85234" />

== Changes ==
* ''Clouds'' (Dark) and ''Scanning Crew'' joined the Premiere - Cloud City ban list.<ref name="t85234" />
* [[Classic (no v-cards)]] and [[Decipher Cards Only (Modified)]] replaced Premiere - Endor and Premiere - Reflections II.<ref name="t85234" />

Geoff Bowman directed Event 4 (76 players) while [[Steve Sanders]] took a break, and Sanders returned for Event 5.<ref name="t85240" />

== ROCS ==
:''Main article: [[Retro Online Championship Series]]''
The top eight in the cumulative standings were invited to the [[Retro Online Championship Series]].<ref name="t86215" /> [[Joe Horbey]] won it, making him the 2025 champion. Final ranking: 1. [[Joe Horbey]], 2. [[Jonny Chu]], 3. [[Andy Talaga]], 4. [[Brad Kippel]], 5. [[Timo Dusel]], 6. [[Paul Todd Feldman]], 7. [[Patrick Johnson]], 8. [[Matt Fendt]].<ref name="t86215" />
